notes: This activation ADR is HITL-ratified=false until the operator signs off — see Plan.json Gate G6_stub_activation.
Activation is fundamentally inert: the flag never causes a non-read action. Activation's sole purpose is to make audit-visible sealed envelopes dispatchable.
Expiry at 90 days is conservative; the goal is to prevent active-maintenance debt, not to enforce industry-wide sunset norms.
The force-kill escalation (--purge_stubs) requires CAMELOT_OPS_EMERGENCY=1 in env; this is a deliberate witness requirement, not a bug.
No secrets present: brvk_* virtual keys are referenced stylistically only — none are emitted into this artifact or the sibling markdown.
